Text.Page:
[EN] I tell you, those beasts and wendigos are nothing...

They're nothing compared to the argons. They're different. It's like they're filling the atmosphere with death.

You think I'm exaggerating, don't you? Trust me, that's what they're like.
[ES] Te digo que esas bestias y wendigos no son nada...

No son nada comparados con los argons. Son diferentes. Es como si llenaran la atmósfera de muerte.

Crees que estoy exagerando, ¿verdad? Créeme, así es como son.
